# Gramlot 0.3.35

## Smaller runtime

- The browser runtime no longer bundles `big.js` or `@xmldom/xmldom`.
  `decimal.js` stays the Decimal of Gramlot; `@genrojs/bag` and
  `@genrojs/tytx` parse XML with the native `DOMParser` of the window.
  `gramlot.min.js` goes from 909 KB to 801 KB (gzip 248 KB to 211 KB).
- Node and the serverless Worker build from the sources and keep both
  packages. `sharedModules` drops their entries.

## Typst is a declared collection

- `typst` carries a WebAssembly compiler of about 41 MiB and leaves the
  standard collections. A page that uses it declares it in `Page.gramlots`:
  Python imports `gramlot.collections.typst`, JavaScript imports the default
  export of `@gramlot/gramlot/collections/typst`. `IdePage` declares it.
- `collections/declared.json` lists the collections the core packages
  outside the standard set; Python reads it with `declared_collections()`.
- `collectionAssets()` of `@gramlot/gramlot/server` replaces
  `standardCollectionAssets()` and lists the entry files of every collection
  the core packages, standard and declared.
- The bootstrap import map, in Python and JavaScript, maps
  `@gramlot/gramlot/collections/<name>` of each collection the page declares,
  so a page module that imports the descriptor also loads in the browser.
